description: Every voice channel has its own text chat. Voice chat cleanup stops members from using that chat while nobody is in the voice channel. Any message sent there while the voice channel is empty is deleted, and Wynem posts a warning in its place.

This is especially useful against scam messages. Scams posted in a voice channel's chat are often missed by moderators, since few people check those chats while nobody is using them. Voice chat cleanup removes them straight away.

description.text: How to use voice chat cleanup

tabs.name: Enabling voice chat cleanup
content: Voice chat cleanup is disabled by default. To enable it, use the e!togglevoicechatcleanup/serverconfig toggle voicechatcleanup command. Wynem needs the Manage Messages and Moderate Members permissions to enable it.

data.title: Voice chat cleanup enabled
data.description: I will now delete messages sent in voice channel chats while nobody is in the voice channel

content: Once enabled, it applies to every voice channel in the server.

tabs.name: Disabling voice chat cleanup
content: To disable voice chat cleanup, use the e!togglevoicechatcleanup/serverconfig toggle voicechatcleanup command again.

data.title: Voice chat cleanup disabled
data.description: I will no longer delete messages sent in empty voice channel chats
